test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 65

questions.question: Three years ago, the population of a city was 2,00,000. If it grew by 3% in the first year, 4% in the second year, and 5% in the third year, what is its present population?
A shopkeeper claims to sell his goods at a 35% loss but uses a false balance and actually makes a 65% gain. What is the actual weight (correct to one decimal place) he gives instead of 1 kg?

In an election, there were only two contestants, D’Souza and Francis. Francis obtained 77% of the number of votes obtained by D’Souza. If the total number of votes polled was 7080 and none of the votes were declared invalid, then find the number of votes obtained by Francis.
The total surface area (in m2) of a cube, each of whose edges measures 107 m, is:
भाग के एक प्रश्‍न में भाजक, भागफल का 20 गुना और शेषफल का 6 गुना है। यदि शेषफल 60 है, तो भाज्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
A person invested ₹5,000 in a scheme offering compound interest at 10% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually. What will be the total compound interest earned?
2% of 47% of a number is what percentage of that number?

A can complete a task in 12 days, and B can complete it in 16 days. They work together for 4 days, and then B is replaced by C. If A and C together finish the remaining work in 3 days, in how many days can C complete the entire task alone?
Reena, Naveen and Arpita invested in a business in the ratio 8 : 13 : 10. They invested their capitals for 2 months, 9 months and 11 months, respectively. What was the ratio of their profits?
Find the smallest 5-digit number that is divisible by 7, 9, and 11.
In a clearance sale of electronic items, an item whose marked price was ₹12,120 is now sold for ₹10,908. D% is the discount percentage on the item. The value of D is:
If the 6-digit number N35M14 is divisible by 11, which of the options below can give a possible correct relation between M and N?
अतुल ने 174 कुर्सियाँ बेचीं और उसे 58 कुर्सियों के विक्रय मूल्य के बराबर लाभ प्राप्त हुआ। उसका लाभ प्रतिशत कितना है?

A trader gives 18% discount on the marked price of an article and gives 28 articles free for buying 120 articles and gains 23% in the entire transaction. Assuming a customer pays for 120 articles, the marked price of an article is what percent more than its cost price?
If the volume of a cube is 512 m3, find the total surface area of the cube in m2.
The average price of three items of furniture is ₹16,710. If their prices are in the ratio 3 : 5 : 7, the price of the cheapest item (in ₹) is:
A and B complete a work in 15 days. If A alone can do it in 24 days, then B alone can do it in _____ days.

A train overtakes two persons walking along a railway track. The first one walks at 7.2 km/h. The other one walks at 10.8 km/h. The train needs 8.2 and 12.3 seconds, respectively, to overtake both of them. What is the speed of the train if both the persons are walking in the same direction as the train?
A man sells a mobile phone for ₹600 and incurs a loss. Had he sold it for ₹1,230, he would have gained 2.5 times the amount of that loss. What is the cost price (in ₹) of the mobile phone?

The marked price of a cooker is the same at four shops I, II, III and IV. Shop I allows two successive discounts of 41% and 43%; shop II allows successive discounts of 56% and 65%; shop III allows successive discounts of 28% and 55% and shop IV allows successive discounts of 40%, 86% and 69% on the marked price of the cooker. Which shop is selling the cooker at the lowest price?
